deal.product_description: The DJI Osmo Nano is a compact, clip-on wearable camera designed for hands-free recording of sports, travel, and daily vlogs without the bulk of a gimbal. It features a 143-degree ultra-wide lens capable of 4K/60fps video with 10-bit color depth and D-Log M professional grading. The device includes built-in 128GB storage with microSD expansion, a 200-minute battery life with fast charging, and is waterproof up to 10 meters for outdoor adventures.

deal.product_description: The Busy Bar is a customizable productivity tool and desk status sign that automatically displays 'Busy' during calls or when specific apps are open. It integrates an RGB LED pixel display (6.35 inches, 72x16 pixels, 800 nits) with open-source firmware and SDKs. The device includes a built-in Pomodoro-style focus timer, mutes notifications on connected devices, and features physical tactile controls for mode selection.
